statement: Whether a W-infinity-invariant U-small sequential ind-object of Cathot admits a sequential presentation by local categories; also the separate general U-small filtered version.
notes: Exact proved criterion is invariance under every unit X→Pi1X, equivalently ind-unit isomorphism, with same-index groupoid presentation. W-infinity invariance implies this criterion remains unresolved. Proved for cofinally1-type stages or representable descended presheaf. Enlarged V-small index version is false by D.7.
